combo_label: At the Seaside × Photography × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Five-armed creature clinging to a stone in the shallows
Diamond of fabric on a long string, flown where the breeze never drops
Roofed with shields, it hosts the battle-dead who spar all day and feast all night
Red-bearded storm god who dressed as a bride to win back his stolen hammer
The foretold doom: sun swallowed, gods felled, and a green world rising after
Rectangle of terry cloth to lie on, dry off with, then shake out for hours
Foreknowing queen of the gods whose oaths from all creation missed one small plant
Instant-print brand whose white-bordered square emerges blank, then blooms
Long heavy barrel that hauls a distant bird right into the frame
Victorian walkway on iron legs, striding out over the water to a pavilion
Allfather who pledged an eye at Mimir's well and hung nine nights on the world tree
Warm brown tone that makes a fresh print look a century old
